input.message:
Went through all 37 issues. My call is on each one in Linear, and the project matches the plan sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1osIXgHnaRra0X2gXjOw3Vlf0b6nwxZIFFOLBcLohHyQ/edit (shared with you and Blake)

**What I'd do**
• **Combo Fighter comes over.** If Sunset can't sell it we buy it out of the sale, plus its AWS account ($62/mo now that Blake killed the leftover copy) and AppsFlyer on the free tier.
• **Domino Delights comes over too.** It made $183 in January, which covers the $140/mo its prod account bills now. Its player support comes with it, but Apple just rejected the email-only support button (Guideline 1.5), so Blake needs to add a support URL before Feb 28.
• **Zombie Match stays with HG.** It made $0 in January against an AWS account that still bills.
• **Everything else stays with HG** per #winddown, apart from Metabase, dbt and GitHub, which Blake is paying on his own card ($248/mo). That includes Figma, which lapses in Sep, so I've changed it from the LLC line on your draft.

**Cost, March–May:** $450/mo total ($202 the LLC pays for the two AWS accounts + $248 Blake pays directly). A third each is **$150/mo**:
• You: $150 cash
• Me: $150 cash
• Blake: $0 cash. His $248 already covers his $150, so the LLC hands back the $98 he's over.

Owners for the open items are on the sheet. Ready for Monday.
